title: Pokémon card resellers have turned collecting into an online blood sport
summary: But another group of Pokémon card hunters was able to secure the highly sought-after set without having to travel to physical retailers or navigate the online Pokémon Center. Retail bots aren’t illegal, but they do violate most retailers’ terms of service.
